SD31-015.name: Double Body Swap
SD31-015.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. If this Burst was activated via [Catalyze], also, you can summon up to two "Ninja Gale" family Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Exhaust all opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits/Ultimates.

SD31-013.name: Earth Release Technique
SD31-013.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the cost, also, the Spirit exhausted by this effect can't refresh until after the end of the next (Opposing Refresh Step).

SD31-005.name: Shinobikogane
SD31-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. When [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the summon cost, also, put a core from the Void to another Spirit you control.

SD31-012.name: Teppounanafushi
SD31-012.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
By discarding your entire Hand (at least one card), draw cards from your deck equal to the number of cards in the opposing Hand.

SD31-002.name: The ArmoredMothShinobi Namitento
SD31-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD31-003.name: The NinjaMaster Higurashi
SD31-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Exhaust every opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

SD31-010.name: The ShinobiCommander Kurohagane
SD31-010.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Also, if this Burst was activated via [Catalyze], exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the attack of your "Ninja Gale" family Spirit with [Soul Core] on it reduces the opposing life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD31-009.name: The WindDemonGreatShinobi Highwind
SD31-009.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Refresh a "Ninja Gale" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can return this Spirit to the Hand. If this Spirit was returned to the Hand by this effect, you can set a card with Burst effect from your Hand.

SD31-007.name: The WindDemon Benimatoi
SD31-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Also , if [Soul Core] is on this Spirit, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD31-X01.name: The WhirlwindNinja Kirikage
SD31-X01.effect:
Flash - [Soul Swift] (Either Attack Step)
You can summon this Spirit card from your Hand by using [Soul Core](Soul Core) from the Reserve to pay the entire summon cost and cores from the Reserve to put onto it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Catl: Green] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to the Trash, immediately activate one of your Green Soul Bursts.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

SD31-014.name: Thousand Shuriken
SD31-014.effect:
[Burst: s] (After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect)
Exhaust two opposing Spirits, and put two cores from the Void to your Reserve. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +4000 BP.
